The '''Massassi Isle''' was an island on the jungle [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. It was located in an ocean off the [[Taurin Delta]]. After the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had [[Evacuation of Yavin|evacuated]] the moon following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], several skirmishes took place on this island between [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance]] and [[Imperial Special Forces/Legends|Imperial Special Forces]]. Several bunkers had been built here.<ref name="SWG:GU10" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Massassi Isle was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GU10" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Massassi Isle was one of the four "[[:w:c:swg:Battlefield|battlefields]]" added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 10|Game Update 10]]," on [[June 2]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=927421|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10}}</ref> The Massassi Isle battlefield was a [[Wikipedia:Player versus player|player versus player]] combat zone where Imperial and Rebel players had to fight for the control of the island. It was only accessible by participating in the Massassi Isle battlefield instance.<ref name="SWG:GU10" />
